author: KEXP
description: LA-based French duo Pearl & The Oysters paint their sonic world in kaleidoscopic art-pop. Live on KEXP, they share a dreamy performance of "Wide Awake" and more.
title: Pearl & The Oysters perform "Wide Awake" & more Live on KEXP
